basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: CTO / Founding Technical Lead · 0-to-1 Enterprise Products · Hardware + Software Systems · AWS & Data Pipelines
basics.summary: Hands-on technical leader and three-time founder who takes products from 0 to 1 and stays in the code. I have shipped hardware-software systems for the real world: at Dronistics I built the cloud backend, data pipelines, APIs, and frontend for an autonomous drone fleet, from field deployment through 500+ real deliveries and a CES showcase toward industrialization. My roots are in hardware (two embedded-systems MSc degrees, an electronics background, a TI analog-design award), so I translate fluidly between hardware, data, and software teams. 13+ years building and years leading engineers (tech lead at Beekeeper, directed a remote team at Obermatt), on AWS with Terraform, Python, and SQL, with pragmatic architecture that fits the stage without overengineering.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who grew and guided the engineering team and owned architecture for a customer-facing platform used by millions.

Owned architecture and built data platforms at scale (Kafka, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Elastic Search) for products used by 10M+ users on AWS and Kubernetes.
Shipped fast and pragmatic: replaced $337K in cost with an LLM pipeline in 6 weeks, deciding when to iterate, fix, or rebuild rather than overengineer.
Made build-vs-buy calls, kept quality high as deployments scaled, and owned reliability and on-call.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Riverkin (early-stage hardware + software startup building sensors and models for real-world environmental/hydrology data). CTO: own the technical roadmap end to end and stay hands-on. Build a reliable, customer-facing enterprise software product fed by data from self-built hardware and self-built models. Sensor prototypes and a software MVP are already deployed in the field with clients; take what exists, challenge it, and define a coherent, scalable path forward without overengineering or restarting from scratch. Think like a builder, not an optimizer; 0-to-1 experience; move fast without losing structure. What you'll do: create clarity and momentum from ambiguous problems; lead, shape and manage the technical team (context, ownership, growth; decide build in-house vs external support; keep quality high as deployments scale); own the technical roadmap (translate product requirements, align to stage, decide iterate/fix/rebuild, path to scale and industrialization); own, build, and industrialize the software architecture (evaluate the current backend, today Python backend, AWS provisioned with Terraform, SQLite, JavaScript frontend; pragmatic UX/APIs/structure to a usable MVP; lead the AWS/GCP cloud backend; build data pipelines from sensor ingestion to usable outputs; remain deeply involved in implementation and debugging; balance scalable architecture with pragmatism; bring to commercialization/industrialization); work with hydrology and hardware teams (translate customer needs into hardware and data direction, support hardware to industrialization, lead the IP roadmap with hardware, define model outputs and their representation in software). Who you are: built and shipped enterprise products from the ground up in a startup; customer-facing; both hands-on developer and architect; worked closely with hardware-software systems; pragmatic early-stage architecture intuition; turn messy inputs into clear direction; build systems that work in the real world; communicate with technical and non-technical teammates. Requirements: strong cloud experience (AWS required); modern backend (Python or Node.js); data pipelines and APIs; comfortable building simple MVP frontends; real-world data systems (IoT / data platforms a strong plus); 7 years building and shipping products; 3 years managing/leading a team; comfortable with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and SQL. Nice to have: data-as-a-service or analytics platforms; previous founder experience.
_jobApplication.notes: Very strong fit: hardware-software systems (Dronistics sensor-and-drone 0-to-1 with cloud backend, data pipelines from sensor ingestion, APIs, MVP frontend, field deployment, CES, industrialization; EPFL robotics; two embedded-systems MSc + electronics B.Tech + TI analog-design award), founder x3, hands-on architect + technical team leadership (Beekeeper tech lead/deputy, led 3 teams, hired cohort; Obermatt directed a remote team), AWS + Terraform (published module) + Python + SQL + data platforms (Kafka/PostgreSQL/ClickHouse), customer-facing products, pragmatic early-stage architecture, data-as-a-service/analytics (PulseView). Honest notes: no formal CTO title yet (founder + tech-lead scale), no hydrology domain (learnable), and IP/patent roadmap is new (has publications, not patents).
